resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Polish source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Polish pass identified 25 actionable terminology, grammar, technical-clarity, and SI-unit defects across circuit, TCR, trigonometric, thermal, heat-flux, and wire-gauge content; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Polish human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The Joule-heating summary said current turns resistance into heat instead of electrical energy.
evidence: The previous summary was Jak prąd elektryczny zamienia opór w ciepło.
findings.resolution: Changed it to electrical energy being converted to heat.

findings.summary: The series-connection definition used awkward Polish grammar.
evidence: The previous bullet said Połączenie szeregowe zapewnia prąd tylko jedną ścieżkę.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as providing current with one path through the components.

findings.summary: The KCL paragraph used aktualne kierunki, which means current/recent directions rather than current directions.
evidence: The previous text used aktualne kierunki before solving.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with kierunki prądu and natural wording for current leaving the node.

findings.summary: The parallel-resistor conclusion used przenosi for branch current.
evidence: The previous conclusion said each branch carries 10 A with an unnatural verb.
findings.resolution: Changed it to each branch carrying 10 A.

findings.summary: The lithium-ion charging warning used an awkward noun phrase for series charging.
evidence: The previous bullet began with Szeregowe ładowanie litowo-jonowe.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as charging lithium-ion cells connected in series with cell-level monitoring.

findings.summary: The TCR example had an incorrect space between the degree symbol and C.
evidence: The previous setup used 20 ° C.
findings.resolution: Corrected it to 20 °C and clarified the TCR statement.

findings.summary: The TCR power paragraph used an awkward literal phrase for a positive-TCR resistor driven by constant voltage.
evidence: The previous text began with rezystancji dodatniej TCR napędzanej.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with natural Polish engineering terminology.

findings.summary: The right-triangle explanation used imprecise Polish descriptions of opposite and adjacent sides.
evidence: The previous paragraph used przeciwna strona and sąsiednia strona as literal noun phrases.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the side definitions and SOH-CAH-TOA explanation.

findings.summary: The triangle example title translated side as a generic page/side term.
evidence: The previous title was Znajdź stronę.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Znajdź bok.

findings.summary: The worked formula localized the protected side label.
evidence: The previous expression used naprzeciwko instead of the protected formula label.
findings.resolution: Restored opposite = 10 × sin(30°) = 5 cm.

findings.summary: The phase-change paragraph used an unnatural term for specific latent heat.
evidence: The previous text used ciepło właściwe utajone.
findings.resolution: Changed it to właściwe ciepło utajone and clarified the phase change.

findings.summary: The heat-flux display name omitted the density/per-area meaning.
evidence: The previous name was Strumień ciepła.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Gęstość strumienia ciepła.

findings.summary: The definition called Q_dot a heat-transfer coefficient instead of a rate.
evidence: The previous text used całkowity współczynnik przenikania ciepła.
findings.resolution: Changed it to całkowita szybkość przepływu ciepła.

findings.summary: The heat-flux conclusion omitted Polish thousands spacing and the density term.
evidence: The previous conclusion rendered 5000 W/m² without a separator.
findings.resolution: Changed it to 5 000 W/m² and gęstość strumienia ciepła.

findings.summary: The final practical-check bullet used a grammatically awkward phrase about heat capacity changing temperature.
evidence: The previous text said it uses heat capacity for temperature change.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as using heat capacity to describe the temperature change.

findings.summary: The SI mass row was corrupted by an unrelated religious phrase.
evidence: The previous row used Msza św instead of Masa.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Masa.

findings.summary: The SI temperature unit used an inflected form unsuitable for the table.
evidence: The previous row used Kelwina.
findings.resolution: Changed it to kelwin.

findings.summary: The nano prefix row had the symbol and factor in the wrong fields after an earlier draft correction.
evidence: The previous row no longer represented nano, n, and 10^-9 consistently.
findings.resolution: Replaced the full row with nano, n, and 0,000000001 = 10^-9.

findings.summary: The wire-gauge display name used a term meaning thickness rather than general wire dimensions.
evidence: The previous name was Grubość drutu.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Wymiary drutu: AWG, SWG i BWG.

findings.summary: The gauge-number guidance used awkward wording for gauge size and numbers above zero.
evidence: The previous bullet used numer miernika and skrajni 0.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with natural Polish terms for gauge size and 00/000/0000 notation.

findings.summary: The TCR coefficient units omitted conventional spacing around division.
evidence: The previous bullet used 1/°C and ppm/°C.
findings.resolution: Changed it to 1 / °C and ppm / °C.

findings.summary: The TCR example heading was a literal translation.
evidence: The previous title was Działający przykład.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Przykład obliczeniowy.

findings.summary: The KVL formula retained an untranslated branch note.
evidence: The previous expression ended with (parallel branches).
findings.resolution: Restored the protected formula and branch-note notation.

findings.summary: The wire-resistance heading used gauge as the primary dimension and omitted wire-size clarity.
evidence: The previous title was Wskaźnik, powierzchnia i rezystancja.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Rozmiar drutu, pole przekroju i rezystancja.

findings.summary: The stranded-wire specification used an awkward term for strand construction.
evidence: The previous bullet used konstrukcję żyły.
findings.resolution: Changed it to konstrukcję splotu.
